title: PRISM/I — Infrastructure Config
description: Validates the .prism-i/config.yaml file that governs PRISM/I framework configuration for a given landscape.

prism_i_version.description: PRISM/I schema version this landscape targets.

landscape_name.description: Human-readable name for this infrastructure landscape.

temporal_mode.description: single-file: one landscape.yaml per dimension, navigated via git history. split-files: separate baseline.yaml and target.yaml per dimension.

author.description: Author or owner of this landscape.

contact.description: Contact email or handle for questions about this landscape.

created_date.description: ISO 8601 date when this landscape was first created.

last_modified.description: ISO 8601 date of the last modification.

reviewed_by.description: Name or handle of last reviewer.

review_date.description: ISO 8601 date of last formal review.
